name: Accessible first
summary: Large text, large targets and AAA contrast, so everyone can finish the task.
description: Accessible first is an Open DS scheme: a full set of answers to the Open DS grammar, with the reasons behind each, usage rules, voice and tone, and the tokens that follow. Large text, large targets and AAA contrast, so everyone can finish the task.

ai.use_when: Public services, health, government and any product that must work for everyone.
ai.avoid_when: Dense expert tools where screen space matters more than size.

scenarios: A person with low vision zooms to 200% and applies for a benefit with a screen magnifier.
A person with a tremor completes a form on a tablet.

voice.summary: Plain and direct. Every sentence is easy to read on the first try.
principles: Use common words. Explain any term you must use.
One idea per sentence. Put the action first.

tone.error: Say what is wrong, where, and exactly how to fix it.
tone.success: Confirm what happened and what comes next.
tone.empty: Explain what will appear here and how to start.
tone.confirm: Say what will happen in plain words, and offer a way back.
tone.onboarding: Say how many steps there are and how long it takes.

examples.text: Enter your date of birth. For example, 27 3 1980.
We have your application. We will email you within 5 working days.
You have no saved applications. Start a new one below.
Do you want to cancel your application? Your answers will be deleted.

answers.question: business.q1
answers.why: A public service everyone must be able to use.

answers.question: business.q2
answers.why: One service, one brand.

answers.question: people.q1
answers.why: Everyone, including people with low vision, motor and cognitive needs.

answers.question: people.q2
answers.why: AAA where it applies; nobody is left out.

answers.question: content.q1
answers.why: Most screens are forms and steps.

answers.question: content.q2
answers.why: One question per screen lowers effort.

answers.question: tasks.q1
answers.why: People must finish the form.

answers.question: tasks.q2
answers.why: People do this once or twice a year.

answers.question: human.q1
answers.why: Low effort to understand each step.

answers.question: human.q2
answers.why: Nobody remembers the interface from last time.

answers.question: outcomes.q1
answers.why: Completion without errors is the measure.

answers.question: outcomes.q2
answers.why: A failed form can cost someone a benefit.

answers.question: brand.q1
answers.why: Calm and clear, never clever.

answers.question: brand.q2
answers.why: The brand stays out of the way.

answers.question: voice.q1
answers.why: Plain and direct words.

answers.question: voice.q2
answers.why: Neutral, respectful formality.

answers.question: team.q1
answers.why: A platform team serves many services.

answers.question: team.q2
answers.why: Changes are rare and tested.

answers.question: typography.q1
answers.why: Few roles keep pages predictable.

answers.question: typography.q2
answers.why: Large text is readable for more people.

answers.question: typography.q3
answers.why: Line height grows with text size for zoom users.

answers.question: color.q1
answers.why: Primary and secondary only; fewer choices, fewer errors.

answers.question: color.q2
answers.why: Never color alone.

answers.question: color.q3
answers.why: Strong but not loud color.

answers.question: spacing.q1
answers.why: Space lowers effort and mis-taps.

answers.question: spacing.q2
answers.why: One density, always generous.

answers.question: spacing.q3
answers.why: Space separates groups.

answers.question: shape.q1
answers.why: Clear, slightly rounded controls.

answers.question: shape.q2
answers.why: Strong borders show where a field is.

answers.question: shape.q3
answers.why: Clear rectangles with a word inside.

answers.question: elevation.q1
answers.why: Flat surfaces with strong borders; shadows are hard to see.

answers.question: elevation.q2
answers.why: If used, subtle.

answers.question: elevation.q3
answers.why: Dimming makes the dialog obvious.

answers.question: motion.q1
answers.why: Motion only confirms an action.

answers.question: motion.q2
answers.why: Moderate speed is easy to follow.

answers.question: motion.q3
answers.why: When asked, nothing moves.

answers.question: iconography.q1
answers.why: Always a word next to an icon.

answers.question: iconography.q2
answers.why: Filled icons are easier to see.

answers.question: iconography.q3
answers.why: Icons a little larger than text.

answers.question: theming.q1
answers.why: Light, dark and high contrast.

answers.question: theming.q2
answers.why: One service, one brand.

answers.question: theming.q3
answers.why: People pick the mode they need.

answers.question: accessibility.q1
answers.why: AAA contrast for text.

answers.question: accessibility.q2
answers.why: Large targets for motor needs.

answers.question: accessibility.q3
answers.why: Every state is visible, loading too.

answers.question: naming.q1
answers.why: Role names are easy to audit.

answers.question: naming.q2
answers.why: Three tiers for a platform team.

answers.question: naming.q3
answers.why: Component keys let services adapt safely.

usage.why: A clear, consistent title on every page.
Every number must be readable at large size.
Large text and short lines lower effort.

usage.use: type.label, above the field, always visible
usage.why: Labels must stay visible while typing.
Selection never relies on color alone.

usage.use: color.status.danger, an icon and a sentence next to the field
usage.why: People must know what went wrong and where.
Underline works without color perception.

usage.use: Badge with an icon and a word
usage.why: Status must survive no color and a screen reader.
Generous space lowers mis-taps.
Space is easy to see; thin lines are not.
Large rows are easy to read and tap.
Clear rectangles read as fields and buttons.
Clear shapes with a word inside.
Shadows are hard to see; borders are not.

usage.use: A strong border and a dimmed page
usage.why: The dimmed page makes the dialog obvious.
Moderate speed is easy to follow.
When people ask for less motion, nothing moves.

usage.use: Not used: always add a word
usage.why: Icons alone are guesswork.

usage.use: The dark semantic mode, or high contrast
usage.why: People pick the mode they can read.
Focus must be seen by everyone.
Large targets help people with motor needs.
One clear next step.
Every action looks like a button people can find.

usage.use: Button secondary, then a confirm page
usage.why: A confirm step prevents a costly error.
A word says what will happen.

moderate.$description: Moderate: a calm, easy-to-follow speed, about 200ms.

relaxed.$description: Relaxed: a slower, springy speed for expressive motion, about 320ms.
